messages:
sam (release): Quick flyby — we need to lock the version for the next minor and close changelog gaps today. Target tag: v0.23.3. Who can take bump + changelog scrub? Please reply with :+1: and PR links.

maria (eng): I can do the frontend bump and add the changelog note for UI latency fix. will open PR in ~30m. :+1:

lee (qa): I'll queue the smoke run once PRs land. Note: run the `smoke-regression` job against staging with the short runset.

sam (release): thx maria. for clarity, use this script to standardize the tag:
```
./scripts/bump_version.sh 0.23.3
git tag -a v0.23.3 -m "release v0.23.3"
```

maria (eng): pushed frontend PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/frontend/pull/802 — includes changelog blurb and version bump. also updated package.json.

lee (qa): kicked off smoke: `/ci/run-smoke --suite short --env staging`
Smoke started at 2026-03-18T00:10Z. I'll post failures here. :eyes:

jordan (docs): docs PR ready and links updated to new version: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/191 — added upgrade notes and breaking-change callout for config key rename.

kevin (security): quick checklist from security: :white_check_mark: dependency scan green, :warning: new config key needs ACL note, :hourglass: I'll do a brief key rotation verification (30–60m). If any infra team added new secrets, flag them.

lee (qa): smoke finished: all critical paths green. One flaky test in routing-service intermittently times out (test 423). Marked as flaky, skipping for canary. Full log: ```
[INFO] smoke-runner: all suites passed except routing-service/test-423 (timeout)
[INFO] artifacts uploaded: s3://ci-artifacts/smoke/3128601122
```

sam (release): good. let's skip the flaky test for canary, track it for follow-up. Maria/jordan: can you both confirm changelog & docs PRs are merge-ready?

maria (eng): merged frontend PR. :shipit:

jordan (docs): merged docs PR and synced redirects. :white_check_mark:

kevin (security): cert scan and dependency check done. no high-risk findings. signed off. :lock:

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: starting at 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z — window 30m. Canary target: 5% traffic across us-west. Rollback hook in place.

sam (release): perfect. final checklist: version tag pushed, changelog entries merged, smoke green, security sign-off. I'll start the canary at scheduled time. If anything odd, ping #eng-oncall and @sam. Thanks everyone. :tada:
